title: Yakitori-Style Chicken Skewers
description: Classic Japanese street food inspired yakitori-style chicken skewers, perfect for a quick and easy dinner. Marinate chicken in a sweet soy-based sauce and grill to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, and brown sugar to make the marinade.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
